nodes.n: Juhu. A white mansion with a gate taller than a bus. A maid leads you past forty framed posters of Tara, all from films she hated.

nodes.t: Sit. Tea? No? Good. Let's not pretend we like each other.
A fake marriage. How clever. Clause seven. How sweet. Do you know what happens if this leaks? Her career ends. Yours too.
I won't leak it. On two conditions. You sign my production house as your personal sponsor. And Tara's next three films are mine to choose.

nodes.th: Tara's next three films. Her whole life, decided in this room.

choice.t: "I'll sign the sponsorship. Leave her films alone."
Record this conversation on your phone.

nodes.t: Half a deal. I'll take it. For now.

nodes.n: Your thumb finds the record button. She keeps talking. Every word.

nodes.t: Think about it. You're not as clever as my daughter, and she isn't very clever.
Brave. My husband was brave. Look where it got him.
You met her? ALONE? I made you promise!
...She did that to my father too. Business deals with his name on them. That's why he...

msgs.t: Board says your wife MUST be in the stands. Kiss-cam and everything. Sorry.

nodes.cliff: Tara Kapoor has never watched a cricket match. On Saturday she has to watch sixty thousand people watching her.
